rule: Thresholds are data (DG-9). Each carries its source, what set it (a standard, a donor's corpus or westack's judgment), a date and a basis: measured, taste or brand. A cut carries a fixture on each side and a band a colour inside and one outside; designcheck.py refuses to run when one is missing or sits on the wrong side. Where donors disagree, a number is carried with its own source and the others are named under disagrees.
calibration: DG-28. Calibrate every detector on a real human-made page beside a seeded template page: run `designcheck.py rules SRC --control HUMAN_PAGE` and record the false positives on the human control. A reflex rule that fires there is held for review instead of gating until someone has looked. Status in this build: not calibrated. No rule here has been run against a real human page; the counts in the source lists (12 failures against 0, 26 against 2) come from runs whose outputs were not saved, so they are claimed only.

contrast-large-and-ui.set_by: WCAG 2.2 success criteria 1.4.3 (large text) and 1.4.11 (icons, focus rings, control edges)

large-text-px.set_by: WCAG 2.2 definition of large text (18 point)
large-text-px.source: ui-ux-pro-max stack/scripts/design-audit.mjs:58-133 (the large-text exemption it samples with)

large-text-bold-px.set_by: WCAG 2.2 definition of large text (14 point bold)

functional-text-min-px.set_by: impeccable's detector calibration (a labelled corpus and a two-judge outcome, as read; not re-measured here)
functional-text-min-px.disagrees: taste-skill fails body under 15px and blocks under 13px (scripts/lib/rules.mjs); hallmark Reflex 75 sets running text at 12px and functional at 11px (design-a.md:30)

tap-target-min-px.set_by: WCAG 2.2 success criterion 2.5.5 (enhanced target size); the 24px minimum of 2.5.8 is an outcome audit for the planned westack-a11y
tap-target-min-px.disagrees: ui-ux-pro-max quick-reference.md:28 gives 24 CSS px for the web and quick-reference.md:37 44pt (iOS) and 48dp (Android)

text-loss-widths-px.set_by: hallmark's render tier (text present at 1440 and lost at 375)

hairline-px.set_by: westack judgment: a length of 1px or less is a hairline the token scan leaves alone

spacing-base-px.set_by: Tailwind v4's default spacing step (0.25rem); a theme's spacing.base overrides it

root-font-px.set_by: the browser default root font size; a project that changes it says so in its record
root-font-px.source: CopilotKit/OpenBot .claude/skills/openbot-screen-layout/SKILL.md:189-199 (a changed root size left every derived constant off)

ref-depth-max.set_by: design.md's resolver cap, so a malformed record cannot hang the checker

card-chrome-max-identical.set_by: westack judgment: three card rules sharing one radius and one shadow is the template tell; the donor names the cluster without a count

band-cream.set_by: taste-skill's colour-family bands (the author's model-panel study, author-reported)
band-cream.disagrees: hallmark Reflex 65 sets paper at OKLCH lightness 90 or more with hue 55-105 (design-a.md:27)

band-terracotta.set_by: hue from taste-skill's band; the saturation and lightness bounds are westack judgment, since the donor's band is read as hue only
band-terracotta.disagrees: hallmark Reflex 65 sets the accent at hue 15-55 (design-a.md:27)

band-violet.set_by: hue from taste-skill's violet band; saturation and lightness bounds are westack judgment

band-blue.set_by: westack judgment: the donors name purple-to-blue gradients without a hue band

text-hold-s.set_by: teardown's review timing (a short phrase holds 1 s, plus 0.25 s per word past three), a heuristic with no study cited that teardown credits to claude-motion's review rules; a starting value a project may set for itself
text-hold-s.source: elvarofficial/teardown SKILL.md:117 (and :144 for the credit), at a91262ac1109051e014662d42ecb0b7bc1f113b1
